reconstruction.scope: Connected Castel Sant Angelo exterior from the original map parent and180 height-tagged building parts: pale masonry base, large brick circular keep and upper galleries/terraces, four corner bastions/curtain walls/battlements, mapped upper rooms/courts, stepped ascent and a real arched south entrance recess/threshold. Original faceted winged roof figure and pedestal are a schematic silhouette. Preserve open ground courtyards, bridge, river and independent Passetto corridor/neighbors. No furnished museum/chambers, copied coats of arms/lettering, crowds, flags or bridge statuary.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Unqualified mapped height/min_height tags from5..43m guide the keep, terraces, outer walls, merlons, upper rooms and niches. Low masonry5m, round core22/31m, outer curtain15m/merlons18m, upper rooms35.5/37/41/42m and crown43m are tagged. Profile boolean coordinates quantized to1mm. Skyline preserves outer courts, simplifies the keep/figure and uses a flat arched portal; district rounds heights to3m and omits small cresting/upper windows, while street/closeup retain mapped voids and real recessed gate. A broad brick corbel/cornice course is photo-led. Existing brick_longformat, stone_limestone_raw, plaster_lime, metal_painted and storefront graphs; no private atlas/embedded pixels.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Standard Protomaps20261020 and original MapzenTerrarium201x201/6m grid. Uncovered south entrance approach fixes datum16.17376865079518m, working floor0.35m.
